knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A clogged cloth filter and dirty dome foam restrict airflow, which reduces suction.
The dome filter and muffler are in place before the bag is seated, so the assembly seals correctly.
A wet filter or foam holds dust and can damage the motor, so it must dry fully before refitting.

practicalCriteria: Identifies the bag, cloth filter, dome filter, muffler and cap on a sample machine.
Cleans and dries each filter and the muffler, then reassembles them in the set order.
Runs a short test and tags the machine if suction is not restored.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 per cent pass mark, so all three must be correct. The practical sign-off is separate, observed by an assessor, and is not shown by a quiz result.
evidenceRequired: Observed practical sign-off on assessor sheet
Service record for the sample machine
stopWorkCriteria: Machine opened while still plugged in
Machine run with a missing or damaged part
Wet filter refitted into the housing
